name: project-roadmap-gantt-chart
title: Project Roadmap Gantt Chart
description: A milestone timeline Gantt visualization displaying deliverable progress across sprints and quarters.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Mosaic
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Gantt Timeline Scrubbing: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
